````text
# #2977: Patch: the Medium and Hard AI keep a 4-drop in the mulligan, as their extra mana makes it a turn-3 play
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Medium and Hard practice opponents get one more mana each turn than you, so a 4-cost card is their natural third-turn play, as a 3-cost card is yours. But their mulligan throws back every card above 3, as if they had your mana, so they often redraw away a good opening hand and stumble early. Once built, those tiers keep cards one cost higher, matching the mana they really have. Easy is unchanged.

## Why
- `crates/ai/src/decide.rs:361` passes `AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost` (3, `crates/ai/src/config.rs:886`) at every tier, and `mulligan_keep` (`crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs:15-26`) keeps only cards costing at most that. The shaped exception lets at most one card at that cost plus one through, and only by its shaped weight.
- The curve check a few lines down already counts the bonus: `early_max_cost = curve.early_turn + handicap_of(side).mana_bonus + coins` (`mulligan.rs:99-100`).
- Medium and Hard have `mana_bonus: 1` (`crates/engine/src/config.rs:441-468`, R181), and a turn's mana is `turns_started + mana_bonus` (`crates/engine/src/mana.rs:27`).

## Proposal
In `mulligan_keep_curved` and the helpers it calls, keep up to `keep_max_cost` plus the seat's `mana_bonus` (never below zero), within its `mana_cap`; the shaped exception moves up with it. `first_turn_max_cost` stays as its own doc says (the bonus does not raise it), and the greedy baseline's `GREEDY_MULLIGAN` is untouched. A ruling in the issue's block records it.

## Where it lands
`crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs`, possibly `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`, the mulligan tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/`, `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/`; SPEC §9.9.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A test named after the new ruling: a Hard-handicap seat keeps a 4-cost card from an opening like 4, 4, 2, 1, 6, and an Easy seat sends it back. The Hard half fails today.
- [ ] Easy's mulligan is unchanged: the existing mulligan tests pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size.

## Size and risks
Tiny: a few lines and a test. It makes Medium and Hard a little stronger, which is the intent, and moves any Duos AI seat with a mana bonus the same way. A fixture that pins a tiered mulligan would need updating.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41758901361)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The AI's mulligan keeps cards costing up to `AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost` (3) **plus the seat's own `mana_bonus`**. It never goes past the seat's `mana_cap` or below 0. It reads whatever handicap the seat holds, not its tier. Medium and Hard have a bonus of 1, a dungeon run's enemy can have any amount (R2922001), and a Duos AI seat has its own. This is how the plan covers "any arbitrary starting mana".

The shaped exception (one proven card costing one more than the bound) moves up with the bound. `first_turn_max_cost` and the greedy baseline's `GREEDY_MULLIGAN` do not move. Easy, a human-resources seat and the tutorial opponent (bonus 0) are unchanged.

A ruling, R2977000, records it. A Hard seat keeps a 4-cost card from 4, 4, 2, 1, 6, and an Easy seat sends it back.

## Files to touch

| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs` | change | new `pub fn mulligan_keep_bound`; `mulligan_keep_curved` uses it; two `saturating_add`s; doc comments |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | comments only, on `AI_MULLIGAN` and `AiMulliganCurve.on` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs` | change | five `r2977000_…` tests inside `mod the_mulligans_curve`, new consts, new imports |
| `spec/rulings/R2977000.md` | new | the ruling note |
| `spec/pending/2977.md` | new | the §11 paragraph |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.9's Search bullet: "The mulligan returns cards costing more than 3" |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | the mulligan paragraph (lines 58–65) |

Do not touch:
- `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`. It already passes `AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost`, and the bonus is read inside `mulligan_keep_curved`, so Duos's `duos_decide` follows because it calls `decide`.
- `skill.rs` and `baselines.rs` (the greedy baseline).
- `crates/engine` and `crates/run`.
- `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` and `bot/`.

Governing rules:
- SPEC §9.9.
- R180, R181 (max mana under a handicap), R244 (The Coin) and R2922001 (a run raises bonus and cap together).
- CLAUDE.md rule 3 (rulings).
- CLAUDE.md rule 4. `crates/ai` stays pure, and `handicap_of` is already imported, so there is no new import.
- CLAUDE.md rule 9. No new number appears.

## Steps

1. **`crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs`:** add this after `mulligan_keep`. `mulligan_keep` itself stays as is, because the greedy baseline calls it.
   ```rust
   /// R2977000: the dearest card `seat`'s mulligan keeps before the shaped exception. `keep_max_cost` is the
   /// bound for a seat with no bonus (the card a human plays on turn 3); the seat's `mana_bonus` (R181) gives
   /// it that many more crystals every turn, so the bound moves up by it, never past the seat's `mana_cap`
   /// (no turn's mana passes it) and never below 0. It reads the seat's handicap, not its tier.
   pub fn mulligan_keep_bound(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId, keep_max_cost: i32) -> i32 {
       let handicap = handicap_of(&state.players[seat]);
       keep_max_cost.saturating_add(handicap.mana_bonus).min(handicap.mana_cap).max(0)
   }
   ```
2. **`mulligan_keep_shaped`:** change `keep_max_cost + 1` to `keep_max_cost.saturating_add(1)`, since the bound can now reach `i32::MAX`. Say in its doc that it takes the bound as given.
3. **`mulligan_keep_curved`:** make the first line of the body `let keep_max_cost = mulligan_keep_bound(state, seat, keep_max_cost);`, ahead of the existing `let shaped = mulligan_keep_shaped(state, seat, keep_max_cost);`.
   - The later `cost <= keep_max_cost` check then reads the raised bound through the shadowing, with no other edit.
   - Rewrite the `early_max_cost` line as `curve.early_turn.saturating_add(handicap_of(side).mana_bonus).saturating_add(coins)`.
   - Leave `first_turn_max_cost` alone.
4. **Comments citing R2977000:**
   - In `mulligan.rs`, update the module header: the bound is `keepMaxCost` plus the seat's bonus.
   - Update `mulligan_keep`'s doc. "Callers pass AI_MULLIGAN's…" becomes: `mulligan_keep_curved` passes `mulligan_keep_bound`'s, and the greedy baseline passes its frozen `GREEDY_MULLIGAN`'s with no bonus.
   - Update `mulligan_keep_curved`'s doc.
   - In `config.rs`, add a comment above `AI_MULLIGAN`: "a seat with no mana bonus's bound; `mulligan_keep_curved` raises it by the seat's bonus (R2977000); `GREEDY_MULLIGAN` is never raised".
   - In `AiMulliganCurve.on`'s doc, change "`mulligan_keep_shaped` exactly" to "`mulligan_keep_shaped` at the seat's bound".
   - Change no value.
5. **`spec/rulings/R2977000.md`:** front matter is `id: R2977000`, a quoted `title`, `cards: "§9.9, R180, R181, R244, R2922001, issue #2977"`, and `proven_in:` with `- crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs`. The body links rulings as `[[R181]]` and covers these points:
   - The bound was a human's turn-3 play.
   - Under R181 a turn's crystals are the turns started plus `manaBonus`, up to `manaCap`, so Medium's and Hard's third turn holds 4.
   - The mulligan keeps up to `keepMaxCost` plus `manaBonus`, within `manaCap` and floored at 0, for any handicap.
   - The shaped exception (the best card one dearer than the bound whose `shaped_weight` reaches `DEAL_MULLIGAN_KEEP`, within the cap) moves with the bound.
   - `firstTurnMaxCost` stays, because R181 does not raise it per its doc. The early-play check already counts bonus and Coin ([[R244]]).
   - `GREEDY_MULLIGAN` stays 3.
   - Easy, a human and the tutorial opponent (bonus 0, cap 3, [[R290]]) are unchanged.
   - Hearthstone semantics: keep what the seat's real mana plays on curve.
6. **`spec/pending/2977.md`:** one paragraph in the shape of `spec/pending/2922.md`: `**[[R2977000]] The AI's mulligan follows its seat's mana (issue #2977, 2026-11-04)**: …`. Say where it came from (the maintainer's "generalize to any arbitrary starting mana" and the dungeon run's raised bonuses) and what it does. End with "It takes R2977000, #2977's first number, and edits [[§9.9]]."
7. **`spec/09-architecture.md`, §9.9 Search bullet:** this is one very long line, so use an Edit on the unique string `The mulligan returns cards costing more than 3, and the AI answers it`. Replace it with `The mulligan returns cards costing more than 3 plus the seat's mana bonus, within its mana cap, so Medium's and Hard's four-drop stays ([[R2977000]]), and the AI answers it`.
8. **`crates/ai/README.md`, lines 59–61:** "sends back every card costing more than `AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost` except the one proven four-drop the shaped keep holds" becomes "sends back every card costing more than `mulligan_keep_bound` (`AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost` plus the seat's mana bonus, within its mana cap, R2977000) except the one proven card one dearer that the shaped keep holds". Leave the rest.
9. Add the tests below, run `cargo fmt`, then run the commands.

## Tests

All tests go in `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs`, inside `mod the_mulligans_curve`. That module owns `kept`, `hand_at`, `costs_hold`, `ONE`, `TWO`, `THREE` and `PROVEN_FOUR`.

**Imports:**
- Add `mulligan_keep`, `mulligan_keep_bound` and `GREEDY_MULLIGAN` to the `jackioh_ai::{…}` list.
- Add `Handicap`, `HUMAN_HANDICAP`, `AI_TUTORIAL` and `MAX_MANA` to the `jackioh_engine::testkit::{…}` list. They all reach through `pub use crate::*`, and `tutorial_tier.rs` already uses `Handicap` this way.

**New consts:**
- `FOUR = "core-034"`: cost 4, shaped weight 0.03, below `DEAL_MULLIGAN_KEEP`.
- `FIVE = "classicplus-064"`: cost 5, weight 1.4. If it will not resolve, use `classic-060`.
- `SIX = "core-029"`: cost 6, weight 0.5.

**Helpers:**
- `fn with(mana_bonus: i32, mana_cap: i32) -> Handicap { Handicap { mana_bonus, mana_cap, ..HUMAN_HANDICAP } }`.
- `fn run_enemy(bonus: i32) -> Handicap { with(bonus, MAX_MANA + bonus) }`. A run raises bonus and cap together.
- `fn on(state: &GameState, handicap: Option<Handicap>) -> GameState` clones the state and sets `players[PlayerId::P2].handicap`.
- `fn costs_four_to_six()` asserts that `query_cost(def_of(None, X))` is 3, 4, 5 and 6 for `THREE`, `FOUR`, `FIVE` and `SIX`.

Every hand comes from `hard_p2_mulligan_with(seed, &[…])`. That gives five cards for p2, who is dealt The Coin. Then apply `on(…)`.

1. `r2977000_a_hard_seat_keeps_a_four_cost_card_from_an_opening_where_an_easy_seat_sends_it_back` is the acceptance test. The hand is `[FOUR, FOUR, TWO, ONE, SIX]`.
   - With Hard's handicap, `must_decide(…, P2, …)` has reason `Mulligan` and `kept` equals `hand_at(&state, P2, 0..4)`.
   - With `on(&state, None)` (Easy), `kept` equals `hand_at(…, 2..4)`.
   - Also assert that `sorted(mulligan_keep(&hard, P2, GREEDY_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost))` equals `hand_at(&hard, P2, 2..4)`. The greedy baseline is untouched.
   - The Hard half fails today, because the seat keeps only the 2 and the 1.
2. `r2977000_the_bound_is_keep_max_cost_plus_the_mana_bonus_within_the_cap_and_never_below_zero` uses `dealt_game("decide-r2977000-bound")` with p2's handicap set per row. `mulligan_keep_bound(&state, P2, AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost)` must be:

   | Handicap | Bound |
   | --- | --- |
   | `None` | 3 |
   | `AI_DIFFICULTY.easy` | 3 |
   | `AI_DIFFICULTY.medium` | 4 |
   | `AI_DIFFICULTY.hard` | 4 |
   | `AI_TUTORIAL` | 3 |
   | `run_enemy(2)` | 5 |
   | `run_enemy(3)` | 6 |
   | `with(3, MAX_MANA)` | `MAX_MANA` (the cap swallows the bonus) |
   | `with(1, 2)` | 2 |
   | `with(-5, MAX_MANA)` | 0 (a handicap the engine would refuse, built by hand to prove the floor) |
   | `with(i32::MAX, i32::MAX)` | `i32::MAX` |
3. `r2977000_a_seat_with_any_bonus_keeps_cards_up_to_three_plus_that_bonus` loops `bonus` over `0..=3` and `(probe, cost)` over `[(THREE, 3), (FOUR, 4), (FIVE, 5), (SIX, 6)]`. The hand is `[ONE, TWO, probe, probe, probe]` on `run_enemy(bonus)`. `sorted(mulligan_keep_curved(&state, P2, AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost, &AI_MULLIGAN_CURVE))` equals `hand_at(…, 0..5)` when `cost <= 3 + bonus`, and `hand_at(…, 0..2)` otherwise. No probe has a shaped weight of 2, so the exception never rescues one.
4. `r2977000_a_cap_below_the_bonus_keeps_nothing_dearer_than_the_cap_and_the_shaped_exception_stays_for_a_seat_with_none` uses the hand `[ONE, TWO, PROVEN_FOUR, PROVEN_FOUR, PROVEN_FOUR]`.
   - No handicap keeps exactly one proven four (`0..3`, the exception).
   - `run_enemy(1)` keeps all five. The bound is 4, so the plain rule applies.
   - `with(1, 3)` keeps `0..2`. The card costs more than the cap, so the clamp sends it back. Without the clamp the plain rule would keep it.
5. `r2977000_the_largest_bonus_and_cap_overflow_nothing` uses `with(i32::MAX, i32::MAX)` and the hand `[ONE, TWO, SIX, SIX, SIX]`. `mulligan_keep_curved` returns all five without a panic. It fails today because `early_max_cost` overflows in a debug build.

The existing mulligan tests stay unchanged and must pass. The Hard p2 tests (`curve_five_one_drops…`, `curve_a_five_card_curve…`) hold no card above 3.

Commands (the AI test binary is `ai`):
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2977000`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai decide::`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai duos::` (Duos AI seats answer through `decide`)
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke size; run it in the background, because it builds release)

## Done when

- [ ] `mulligan_keep_bound` exists and `mulligan_keep_curved` uses it. `mulligan_keep`, `GREEDY_MULLIGAN`, `decide.rs` and `first_turn_max_cost` are untouched.
- [ ] The five `r2977000_…` tests pass. The Hard half of test 1 fails on `main`, and Easy's existing mulligan tests pass.
- [ ] R2977000's note, `spec/pending/2977.md`, §9.9 and the README are edited. `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md` are not.
- [ ] rustfmt, clippy on `jackioh-ai`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh gate` pass.
- [ ] No `#[allow]`, no `#[ignore]` and no weakened assertion.

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay.** Only the AI's mulligan answer changes, and only for seats with `mana_bonus > 0` (Medium, Hard, Duos AI teams, run enemies).
  - Recorded logs fold their stored actions, so no replay or golden fold moves.
  - The new function reads only the seat's own handicap, which `redact` keeps, so no hidden card changes a decision.
- **The cap clamp outside the bonus case.** It also applies to a seat whose cap is below the bound. None exists in code: the tutorial's cap equals 3, and a human's cap of 4 exceeds 3.
- **Overflow.** `mana_bonus` can be huge, because `fight.rs` uses `saturating_add`. Every sum here saturates, and test 5 proves it.
- **The gate.** Smoke games of `hard-vs-easy` get a little stronger for Hard. If a gate fails, report it by name and do not lower a floor. The statistical AI gates and the full e2e run daily.
- **The exception moving up** cannot be proven with the catalog, because no card of cost 5 or more has `shaped_weight` ≥ 2. It holds by construction, since `mulligan_keep_shaped` already tests `bound + 1`. Test 4 proves the plain rule and the cap.

## Open questions

- "Starting mana" is read as the handicap's `mana_bonus` and `mana_cap`, the only starting-mana fields that exist. If the dungeon run later adds a separate starting-crystals field, the bound should read it too.
- `first_turn_max_cost` stays 1 for every bonus, as the issue says. A seat with a large bonus may deserve a higher one.
````
